tool_input.content:
<template>
  <view class="skeleton-image" :style="boxStyle" @click="emit('click', $event)">
    <Skeleton v-if="loading" :w="w" :h="h" :r="r" />
    <image
      v-if="src && !failed"
      class="skeleton-image__image"
      :src="src"
      :mode="mode"
      :style="imageStyle"
      @load="loading = false"
      @error="onError"
    />
    <image v-else-if="fallback" class="skeleton-image__image" :src="fallback" :mode="mode" :style="imageStyle" />
  </view>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref, watch } from 'vue'
import Skeleton from './Skeleton.vue'

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<{
  src: string
  w?: string
  h?: string
  r?: string
  mode?: 'scaleToFill' | 'aspectFit' | 'aspectFill' | 'widthFix' | 'heightFix'
  fallback?: string
}>(), {
  w: '64px',
  h: '64px',
  r: '6px',
  mode: 'aspectFill',
  fallback: '/static/assets/icon_image_placeholder.svg',
})
const emit = defineEmits<{ click: [event: Event] }>()
const loading = ref(!!props.src)
const failed = ref(!props.src)
const w = computed(() => props.w)
const h = computed(() => props.h)
const r = computed(() => props.r)
const boxStyle = computed(() => ({ width: props.w, height: props.h, borderRadius: props.r }))
const imageStyle = computed(() => ({ width: props.w, height: props.h, borderRadius: props.r }))
watch(() => props.src, (src) => {
  loading.value = !!src
  failed.value = !src
})
function onError() {
  loading.value = false
  failed.value = true
}
</script>

<style scoped>
.skeleton-image {
  position: relative;
  display: inline-block;
  overflow: hidden;
  vertical-align: middle;
}
.skeleton-image__image {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
}
</style>
